description: Join two formats this document **already** declares: a `link` column on `format`, so each of its rows belongs to one row of `target` — each `recipe_line` belongs to one `recipe` — and, optionally, a total on `target` along it (an `aggregate`): `recipe.total_kcal`, the sum of `amount_g / 100 * ingredient.kcal` over the lines that name it. This is how a format gets a total of another declared after it, which `declare_format` cannot do. Name an existing link as `column` to add only the total. **It only adds**: a link may be empty, so rows already there lose nothing; `required: true` on a format that has rows is refused. A connection is removed with `extend_format` `remove` (the link column once its cells are emptied, or the total); re-pointing one is done at `#/connections` in the app. Returns what it would add and writes nothing until `commit: true`.

aggregate.description: The total `target` keeps of the rows that name it: a `name` in `snake_case`, an `of` — one of sum, count, average, minimum, maximum — a `works_out` expression over each of those rows in their own vocabulary (their computed columns too, and one hop, `ingredient.kcal`). A `count` needs no `works_out`. It takes a `unit` (none for money: it keeps its currency), `where` (only the rows that match: `status is DONE`, `kind is not X`, `kind is one of X, Y`, `author is empty`) and `note`. No `over_*`: this link is what it folds over.

column.description: The link column’s name, `snake_case`. Defaults to the target’s name, suffixed if taken. Name an existing link to it to add only the total.

commit.description: Write it. Omit or false for the dry run.

format.description: The format that gets the link — the many side, `recipe_line`.

found_by.description: How the link fills itself while empty: `date in period` (this date’s month) or `date on paid_on` (the same day). No row or two is refused by name; a link a person set stays.

note.description: What the link means. Kept with the declaration, word for word.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

required.description: Every row must name one. Refused on a format that already has rows.

target.description: The format each row belongs to one of — `recipe`, the one side.

name: connect_formats
title: Connect two formats
